# OpenAI Codex Changelog — captured 2026-07-04

## June 25, 2026 — Codex Remote GA + CLI 0.142.1 / 0.142.2 [new]
- **Codex Remote reaches General Availability**: mobile control of connected Mac/Windows hosts via authenticated QR pairing between iOS/Android devices and host machines. (Previously the remote-control/pairing surface was in beta; now GA.)
- **New DigitalOcean plugin**: provisions and configures DigitalOcean Droplets as remote Codex workspaces — new cloud-provisioning integration/connector.
- **CLI 0.142.2**: MCP tools use **tool search by default** when supported; macOS auth clients honor system proxy/PAC/WPAD; plugins support dark-mode logos via local manifests; remote stdio MCP servers accept absolute native-path working dirs; PowerShell commands with unlowered AST regions now require approval.
- **CLI 0.142.1**: Windows system proxy support (PAC, WPAD, static proxies, bypass rules).
- (AIRT/ENDPOINT MEDIUM: Codex Remote GA = phone-to-host agent remote control now broadly available; DigitalOcean plugin = new agent cloud-provisioning connector; MCP tool-search-by-default = new default MCP tool-discovery behavior. Reportable.)

## June 22, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.142.0 + ChatGPT iOS 1.2026.167 [prior scan]
- CLI: `/usage` credits; `/plugins` curated/workspace/shared sections; configurable rollout token budgets; **multi-agent delegation modes** (disabled/explicit-request-only/proactive); **indexed web-search mode** (server-approved URLs only); scheduled UTC reminders; exec-server survives disconnects w/ signed-URL refresh; parental agents receive terminal subagent errors.
- iOS 1.2026.167: per-host personality settings; inline goal editing; fork tracking.
- (AIRT MEDIUM: multi-agent delegation modes + indexed web-search — already reported prior scan.)

## June 18, 2026 — Codex app 26.616 [prior scan]
- Record & Replay (macOS): demonstrated workflows → reusable skills. Thread handoff local↔remote. Bulk run-history actions.

## June 18, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.141.0 [prior scan]
- Noise-relay E2E-encrypted remote exec; per-thread plugin stdio MCP servers; realtime speech append/response control.
